_note: A distillate of that run's own artifacts: the risk register from scenario-plan.json and the outcome records from iteration-01/suite-result.json, copied verbatim. runs/ is not committed, so this is what keeps the regression.

risks.description: An adapter timeout AFTER the outside world may have been touched must resolve to UNKNOWN_OUTCOME with exactly one EffectAttempted and never to FAILED (which asserts positive non-occurrence). A timeout path that writes a second EffectAttempted, orphans one, or downgrades to FAILED would either double-touch the outside world or lie about non-occurrence.
risks.basis: machine 03-external-effect-grant EF-3u; task: 'timeout, crash or lost response -> UNKNOWN_OUTCOME', 'FAILED only when non-occurrence is positively known', 'exactly one EffectAttempted per logical effect'

risks.description: A process crash after EffectAttempted but before the adapter return must land in UNKNOWN_OUTCOME with no orphan and no second effect. A crash path that re-executes on recovery double-touches the outside world.
risks.basis: fault vocab 'adapter-crash EF-3u the process dies after EffectAttempted, before the return'

risks.description: Restart between mint and claim must leave zero leaked claims/effects; restart after the CAS must never re-execute the effect. A restart that re-runs the claim or the adapter breaks exactly-once.

An approval withdrawn between mint and the claim CAS must make the CAS match zero rows so the adapter does absolutely nothing. If revalidation does not consume approval atomically at the CAS, a stale approval executes an unapproved external effect.
risks.basis: fault vocab 'approval-revoked-mid-claim EF-2r'; task: 'the claim revalidates expiry, brake and policy at the claim instant', 'minimum atomic approval-consumption seam at the claim CAS'

risks.description: A strict-order consumer must block on an unapplied F14 predecessor (order, not contiguity) rather than consuming out of order or treating an absent version as terminal. Getting this wrong applies effects against stale/incomplete aggregate state.
risks.basis: P6-D11 complete-stream behaviour; fault vocab predecessor-unapplied P6-D11 §8 / F14

risks.description: A parked event must be able to leave the park via drain_handler_for; without it the only exit is M-26 expiry, stranding the obligation. M3 is the first strict consumer, so this closes here.
risks.basis: P6-D24; fault vocab 'park-and-drain P6-D24 the event parks and drain_handler_for is invoked'

risks.description: The mutation axis must be a closed surface: a dimension value outside its stated range, and a real fault name applied to an incoherent case, must both exit 2 with a readable message and no traceback. A silent fallback or stack trace makes every passing generated run meaningless.
risks.basis: task: 'a value outside the stated range must exit 2', 'An injected fault meaningless for a given case should exit 2 with a clear message', 'not a traceback, and never a silent fallback to none'

risks.description: The generator can only compose situations it can discover. If --list-cases omits a case or --list-dimensions omits a flag/fault, that behaviour is unreachable through the only interface a generated scenario can use.
risks.basis: task: '--list-dimensions must print all six flag names and every fault name'; 'a focused argument-only entry point is the only way it can compose new situations'

risks.description: M3 must ship dark: nothing under src/freight_recon may import external_effect, only probe_phase6_external_effect.py may under scripts, and the mutation battery must not import it. A stray import wires an unfinished engine into the live product.
risks.basis: task §Ship dark; Do-not: 'enable live production effects', 'M1 and M2 ship dark, and M3 ships dark too'
covered_by: p6_m3_external_effect: A brake or a policy bump arriving between mint and claim makes the CAS match zero rows; no timer moves UNKNOWN_OUTCOME; and an UNKNOWN_OUTCOME always has a named human owner.

risks.description: The effect_grants -> pipeline_instances FOREIGN KEY (the M2 seam) must hold so a grant cannot dangle off a non-existent pipeline instance. M2/M3 consistency driven through the probe must not contradict the durable referential integrity.
risks.basis: task Schema: 'FOREIGN KEYs, tenant-first, from effect_grants to checkpoint_witnesses and to pipeline_instances'
